title: An ROI statement lists the lines its actionable figure counted
assertion: The writer stores, beside the figure, the priced lines it summed, read in one pass from the same rows: each case's figure equal to `ACTIONABLE_NOW` run as its own query and to the two-subquery path row for row, on the fixture worlds and a generated month; the stored row is the one before but for the list; the page, the CSV, the list and the print job receive the four keys they read and show what they showed
